fn hasPath(allocator: mem.Allocator, grid: [][]const u8, height: usize, width: usize, player: u8, is_vertical: bool) !bool {
    // is_vertical true means check top-to-bottom (for 'O')
    // is_vertical false means check left-to-right (for 'X')
    
    var visited = try allocator.alloc([]bool, height);
    defer {
        for (visited) |row| allocator.free(row);
    }
    for (visited, 0..) |_, r| {
        visited[r] = try allocator.alloc(bool, width);
        @memset(visited[r], false);
    }
    defer {
        for (visited) |row| allocator.free(row);
    }
    
    var queue = std.ArrayList([2]usize).init(allocator);
    defer queue.deinit();
    
    // Initialize queue with starting positions
    if (is_vertical) {
        // 'O': all 'O' cells in row 0
        for (0..width) |c| {
            if (grid[0][c] == player) {
                visited[0][c] = true;
                try queue.append(.{0, c});
            }
        }
    } else {
        // 'X': all 'X' cells in column 0
        for (0..height) |r| {
            if (grid[r][0] == player) {
                visited[r][0] = true;
                try queue.append(.{r, 0});
            }
        }
    }
    
    while (queue.items.len > 0) {
        const cell = queue.orderedRemove(0);
        const r = cell[0];
        const c = cell[1];
        
        // Check if reached the opposite side
        if (is_vertical and r == height - 1) return true;
        if (!is_vertical and c == width - 1) return true;

                visited[nr][nc] = true;
                try queue.append(.{nr, nc});
            }
        }
    }
    
    return false;
}
